zh: 每个合法中心都要求一个 (2r+1)×(2r+1) 窗口的和，逐格累加太慢；二维前缀和可以 O(1) 求任意矩形的和。
所有窗口都基于原图计算，所以先对原图建前缀和，再把结果写进另一个数组，不能边算边覆盖。只有窗口完整落在图内的中心（行在 [r, h−r)、列在 [r, w−r)）才替换，其余像素保持原值。
令 p[i+1][j+1] = a[i][j] + p[i][j+1] + p[i+1][j] − p[i][j]。对合法中心 (i, j)，窗口和为 p[i+r+1][j+r+1] − p[i−r][j+r+1] − p[i+r+1][j−r] + p[i−r][j−r]，新值为它整除 (2r+1)²。最后按 h 行、空格分隔输出整个矩阵。
en: Every valid center needs the sum of a (2r+1) x (2r+1) window, and adding cells one by one is too slow; a 2D prefix sum gives the sum of any rectangle in O(1).

All windows use the original image, so build the prefix sums on the original and write results into a separate array instead of overwriting as you go. Only centers whose window lies fully inside the image (rows in [r, h-r), columns in [r, w-r)) are replaced; every other pixel keeps its value.

Let p[i+1][j+1] = a[i][j] + p[i][j+1] + p[i+1][j] - p[i][j]. For a valid center (i, j) the window sum is p[i+r+1][j+r+1] - p[i-r][j+r+1] - p[i+r+1][j-r] + p[i-r][j-r], and the new value is that sum divided by (2r+1)^2, rounded down. Print the matrix as h space-separated rows.

explanationEn:
## Approach

A 2D prefix sum gives the sum of any square window in constant time; each valid center is replaced by the quotient of the window sum divided by the window area.

## Correctness

Inclusion-exclusion on the prefix sums gives the window sum of the original image, and integer division rounding down is exactly the floor mean of the statement; only centers of complete windows are written, and all other cells keep their original values.

## Complexity

O(hw) time and space.
